{{Quote|Intel says the Hidden Chain are going to hit an out-of-the-way spot on Ord Mantell|[[Jekiah Ordo]]|<ref name="TOR:RtN" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, Hidden Chain forces led by [[Tyrus Brokenblade]] '''raided''' the settlement of [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in order to capture hostages and obtain coolant rods from the local [[Geothermal Station|geothermal plant]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] raiders and their [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] allies were eventually defeated by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]. While the Commander was able to prevent them escaping with half their desired assets, the Mandalorians managed to escape with the other half while they fought Brokenblade.<ref name="TOR:StC" />
